svg.title: AI Loan Underwriting Platform — System Architecture
svg.desc: Six-layer architecture: data, training pipeline, model governance, serving (fraud gate, credit engine, document floor, confidence, explanation, audit trail, RAG, LLM explainer, letter PDF, chatbot), clients and monitoring.
svg.text: AI Loan Underwriting Platform — System Architecture
DATA LAYER — training data (left three) · runtime inputs (right two)
TRAINING PIPELINE — one shared orchestrator, run once per engine (credit · fraud)
filter: gap · CV std · min F1
SERVING — FASTAPI POST /underwrite → make_final_decision() (champion models loaded at startup)
fraud BLOCK short-circuits: credit is never consulted
load_audit_trail(application_id) — explain, letter and chat all read the saved decision
